item.title: Mask My File — Redact files before sharing | iOS App
item.description:
Share safely without losing the context people actually need. Mask My File finds private details before you send a file, permanently hides only what you choose, then reopens and verifies the new copy before showing Private Ready. WHAT YOU CAN DO • Images and PDFs: full-width preview, up to 5× zoom, fluid drag, and precise manual selections. • Visual files: permanent solid redaction or removal only. Face and barcode detection simply mark regions for your review. • Text, JSON, XML, HTML, CSV, TSV, and RTF: search every match, then apply a full mask, a partial mask, a placeholder, a pseudonym, or removal. • Remove metadata where the format supports it. Work page by page in PDFs, or protect up to 100 files at once with individual previews, cross-file search, and per-file manual selections. • Stay organized with Private Session, project workspaces, and Placeholder Vault. USE IT WHEN IT MATTERS Before you send a rental application, a medical record, a pay stub with a Social Security number, or a customer file to a coworker, keep the useful context while permanently hiding the details they do not need. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Everything is processed on your device. There is no account, advertising, tracking, analytics, or content upload. Apple Vision and the embedded Tesseract OCR engine run locally. Face detection creates regions only: it does not identify a person, build a template, share face data, or retain it. Apple handles purchases with StoreKit. Mask My File does not use a VPN, NetworkExtension, proxy, tunnel, DNS filter, or network routing. Originals are never overwritten; temporary workspace files, Private Session data, and projects stay on the device until you delete them. BUY ONCE. USE IT FOR LIFE. One purchase unlocks unlimited verified outputs and batch processing for good. No subscriptions. Restore your purchase anytime through the App Store.

App Store · Free

item.title: Aim990 Plus — Offline Exam Pressure Trainer | iOS App
item.description:
Train for clear decisions under exam pressure Aim990 Plus is a focused listening and reading trainer for serious adult learners. It turns preparation into a repeatable loop: begin with an 8-question mixed Warm-up, move into a 20-question Pressure Set with a 15-minute limit, then use Mistake Replay to revisit what went wrong. A complete original question bank Work through 630 original questions, organized as 90 items in each of Parts 1–7. The visual material includes 90 distinct photos. Questions are created for this app and are not presented as official exam content. Practice for the way you need to improve Choose mini, half, or full mock formats when you want a longer test session. Use dictation to catch details, speed drills to make decisions under tighter timing, and device speech for additional audio practice. A 150-entry vocabulary collection helps you review useful language alongside the question bank. Turn mistakes into a plan Weakness analytics highlight areas that deserve more attention. Your progress and profile keep sessions connected, while Mistake Replay gives missed questions another purposeful pass instead of leaving them behind. Private by design The app works offline and keeps its core experience on your iPhone or iPad. There is no account, server connection, advertising, tracking, or analytics. One paid download includes every feature: there are no in-app purchases, subscriptions, or paywalls. Aim990 Plus is an independent study tool for adult learners. TOEIC is a trademark of ETS.
